coverage: UTC hours 2026-10-17T21:00Z → 2026-10-19T19:00Z of recorded pageviews in this pull.
era_note: Companion (asset) collection began Oct 18, 2026; the join is computed from Oct 19, 2026 — no silent backfill: pageviews from before companion collection cannot match and count as unrendered. Coverage, stated plainly: the sites' pages are self-contained and load almost no external assets, so the companion supply is thin — mostly favicon fetches from real browsers and referer-less scanner probes for configuration files, which can never join. A rendered count near zero here means this instrument sees almost nothing, not that nothing rendered; the render-claim beacon (<site>-renders.json) is the stronger render signal on these sites.
method: A pageview (a status-200 read of an HTML page) counts as rendered when a companion (asset) record exists with the same visitor digest, the companion's referring page equal to the pageview's path, and the same UTC hour. The digest join is exact; the time join is hour-granular, so the rendered count is an upper bound within the hour, never a per-request certainty. A companion record proves a browser-class fetch of the page's own assets happened — strong evidence of a render, not a screenshot. Digest values are never published.
